target_customer: TypeScript developers and companies building apps who want auth on their own database; paid hosted infrastructure for scaling teams
problem: Developers want full featured authentication embedded in their backend without lock in to a hosted provider.
business_model: Open source MIT framework with planned paid infrastructure layer (dashboard, security, email and SMS, session storage)

founders.name: Bereket Engida
founders.background_notes: YC page lists his open source projects (Better Call, Better Fetch, Loglib, Better Auth); TechCrunch describes him as a self-taught Ethiopian developer who built the product in Ethiopia. Education and employers not found in opened sources.

competitors.name: NextAuth (Auth.js)
competitors.what: Open source auth library for Next.js
competitors.traction_then: About 2.5M weekly npm downloads per a comparison guide

competitors.name: Lucia
competitors.what: Open source TypeScript session library, deprecated March 2025
competitors.traction_then: About 500K weekly downloads per same guide

technical_complexity.rationale: Security sensitive framework with plugins (passkeys, 2FA, organizations) that a solo founder shipped; standard engineering with careful security work.

defensibility.rationale: Open source MIT code is copyable, but embedded auth on the user's database creates switching costs and community plugins add pull; downloads reached about 20M weekly per the site.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Vercel acquired Better Auth in July 2026, hiring the core team and keeping the MIT license; financial terms were not disclosed.

market_need_then: Lucia was deprecated in March 2025 and NextAuth had limits, leaving demand for a full featured TypeScript auth framework; the founder says the idea came from repeated auth pain in remote jobs (TechCrunch).

branding.name_origin: The founder says he came up with better-auth, liked it, then found it free on npm, which started the project (podcast interview, via search result).
branding.domain_note: Name was available on npm; site is better-auth.com (hyphenated)

identity.logo: Not described; site uses 3D logo art
identity.visual_style: Light and dark themes, 3D logo art

branding.community_and_virality: Strong developer community: 31k GitHub stars and 1,005+ contributors per site; Peak XV called it its first direct investment in an African founder

brand_strength.rationale: Descriptive name is easy to remember inside developer circles but generic for search; growth came from open source adoption rather than the name.

outcome_analysis: Better Auth grew from an open source TypeScript framework into a project with tens of millions of weekly downloads, raised a $5M seed in June 2025 led by Peak XV, and was acquired by Vercel in July 2026 with the core team joining and the MIT license kept. Success rested on open source distribution, the Lucia deprecation timing tailwind and fast solo execution, though no price was disclosed.
notes: Directory status says Active but sources report the Vercel acquisition announced July 7, 2026 (vercel.com and secondary coverage); the Vercel page itself was only seen as a search result. Seedtable lists Chapter One as lead, conflicting with the company post naming Peak XV. One search result named a second founder (KinfeMichael Tariku); not on the YC page, so not listed. Founded year not confirmed.
